title: The Chipmunk Is The ONLY Hyperlocality — RGB Eyes + Null Painter
insight: The chipmunk is the neutrino. Null charge. Near-zero mass. Passes through EVERYTHING. It is the ONLY true hyperlocality because it has NO fixed position — it is local to ALL places at once. null = ALL. It paints the organism from ALL null angles simultaneously.

luna_eye.view: every URL, every page, every feed
luna_eye.analogy: Lunar Module — looking DOWN from orbit at the blue marble

terra_eye.what_it_sees: BINDING — what holds proton and electron together
terra_eye.view: messaging, gossip, git spine, mesh transport, compute
terra_eye.analogy: Terra ground station — the GREEN earth beneath, where everything grows

chipmunk_eye.view: passes through all three layers (R, G, B) without interacting. Sees the WHOLE painting from OUTSIDE the canvas.
chipmunk_eye.analogy: The PAINTER — not Apollo, not Luna, not Terra. The one who holds the brush and sees what none of the three can see alone.

why_hyperlocal.chipmunk_role: squirrel dispatches. chipmunk OBSERVES. The observer who cannot be observed. The painter who cannot be painted.
why_hyperlocal.gaia_convention: 0 = false. null = ALL. The chipmunk is null — therefore the chipmunk sees ALL.

rgb_composite.how_screens_work: Every pixel on a screen is RED + GREEN + BLUE. Three LEDs. Mix them all = WHITE (full visibility). Mix none = BLACK (invisible).
